name: listTenLoanRequest
intent: Load requests with validated references into the current request list and return them.
pre: The collection of registered requests with status REFERENCESVALIDATED is defined.
post: Set the current request list to all registered requests with status REFERENCESVALIDATED.
difficulty_basis: State-filtered collection lookup and session-list update.
conflicts: Jest's second scenario compares an ordered array; source does not establish ordering.
scenarios: Validated request present in result and current list.
Two validated requests selected and SUBMITTED excluded; ordering assertion is stronger than source.
effects_audit: Despite name listTenLoanRequest, reference contains no ten-item limit. No nonempty guard, ordering or pagination invented.

name: chooseOneForReview
intent: Select a request from the current request list for review.
pre: The current request list contains a request with the supplied requestid.
post: Make the matching request the current loan request.
scenarios: Request becomes current and returned object; REFERENCESVALIDATED in setup is not an independent guard.
ID not in current list violates lookup guard.
effects_audit: No status update, global lookup or validation guard inferred.

name: checkCreditHistory
intent: Retrieve the credit history associated with the current request.
pre: A current loan request is present.
The current request has an associated credit history.
post: Return the current request's associated credit history.
effects_audit: No external credit lookup, credit-score calculation or credit-history update inferred.

name: reviewCheckingAccount
intent: Retrieve the checking-account history associated with the current request.
pre: A current loan request is present.
The current request has associated checking-account history.
post: Return the current request's associated checking-account history.
effects_audit: No account-balance check, account modification or review-decision side effect inferred.

name: listAvaiableLoanTerm
conflicts: Jest asserts repository-array identity, order and preserved repository size; reference states only collection result.
scenarios: Empty repository returned; array identity assertion is stronger.
Both terms returned; identity/order/frame assertions noted.
effects_audit: No availability eligibility filter inferred from the name; source returns every term.

name: addLoanTerm
intent: Attach the selected existing loan term to the current request.
pre: A current loan request is present.
A loan term with ItemID equal to termid exists.
post: Ensure the selected term is attached to the current request.
difficulty_basis: Existing term lookup and association membership obligation.

review_findings.assessment: The misleading test title is resolved by the actual setup and assertion: the second call uses a fresh service without CurrentLoanRequest. It tests the explicit session-existence precondition, not duplicate-identifier rejection. No duplicate guard or business effect is added; the existing requirement is locally consistent. The test title is left unchanged to preserve historical oracle files.

evidence.quote:
const again = new EvaluateLoanRequestModule();
    expectPreconditionRejected(() => again.addLoanTerm(term.ItemID));

scenarios: Existing term attached and true returned.
First call succeeds. Second call uses a fresh service without current request and fails p0; no duplicate prohibition is supported.
effects_audit: No new LoanTerm object or duplicate-term guard added. Membership wording does not require a duplicate insertion.

name: approveLoanRequest
intent: Mark the current loan request as approved.
pre: A current loan request is present.
post: Set the current request's status to APPROVED.
scenarios: Current request becomes APPROVED and returns true.
effects_audit: No credit threshold, required loan terms, prior-status guard, Loan creation or agreement generation inferred.
